en.prompt: How would your team describe an "AI agent" today?
en.help: There is no wrong answer. It tells us where to pitch the first conversation.
en.gap: Start with a shared vocabulary. A short session on what an agent is — and how it differs from a chatbot — stops a room agreeing on a word while meaning different things by it.

zh.prompt: 如果现在问你的团队，「AI agent」是什么？
zh.help: 没有标准答案。它决定我们第一次对话该从哪儿讲起。
zh.gap: 先把话说到一处去。用一场短会讲清 agent 是什么、和聊天机器人差在哪——否则一屋子人会对着同一个词点头，心里想的却是不同的东西。

options.en: We have heard the word but could not explain how it differs from a chatbot
options.zh: 听过这个词，但说不清它和聊天机器人有什么区别

options.en: Roughly — we could name one or two things it might do
options.zh: 大概知道，能说出一两个它可能有用的地方

options.en: Clearly — we know it can use tools and carry out multi-step work
options.zh: 比较清楚，知道它能调用工具、完成多步骤的活儿

options.en: Clearly, and we have already argued internally about how to run one safely
options.zh: 很清楚，而且内部已经讨论过怎么让它安全地跑起来

en.prompt: How much do your colleagues actually use AI tools in a normal week?
en.help: Actual use, not what the policy allows.
en.gap: Everyday familiarity comes first. People who have never used AI on their own work cannot judge which of their tasks an agent should take over.

zh.prompt: 平常一周里，同事们实际用 AI 工具用到什么程度？
zh.help: 问的是实际在用，不是制度上允不允许。
zh.gap: 先有日常的手感。一个从没在自己工作上用过 AI 的人，判断不出哪一段活儿该交给 agent。

options.en: Almost nobody uses them
options.zh: 基本没人用

options.en: A few people, on their own initiative
options.zh: 少数人自己在用

options.en: Quite a few use them daily, but everyone in their own way
options.zh: 不少人天天用，但各用各的

options.en: Widely used, with shared internal examples of what works
options.zh: 普遍在用，而且内部有推荐的用法和现成例子

en.prompt: Has anyone here put AI inside an actual work process — not just chatted with it?
en.help: Inside a process means it runs as part of how the work gets done, with nobody copying and pasting in the middle.
en.gap: There is a large step between using AI and building with it. Plan for the first build to be a learning exercise on a low-stakes process, not a flagship.

zh.prompt: 有没有人把 AI 嵌进过一个真实的工作流程里——不只是拿来聊天？
zh.help: 「嵌进流程」是指它成了这活儿运转的一部分，中间不需要人来回复制粘贴。
zh.gap: 从「用 AI」到「用 AI 建东西」中间有一大步。第一次动手请挑一个低风险的流程当练习，不要挑门面工程。

options.en: No
options.zh: 没有

options.en: We built a demo, but it never went live
options.zh: 做过 demo，但没上线

options.en: One or two are running
options.zh: 有一两个在跑

options.en: Several are running, and we reuse what we learned
options.zh: 有好几个在跑，而且经验被复用起来了

en.prompt: When AI gets something wrong, what happens in your organisation today?
en.help: Every organisation lands somewhere on this. It decides how much of the first agent can run unattended.
en.gap: Agree what an agent may decide alone and what a person must confirm — before the first one ships, not after it makes a mistake in front of a customer.

zh.prompt: AI 答错了的时候，你们组织现在是怎么处理的？
zh.help: 每家公司都在这条线上的某个位置。它决定第一个 agent 能有多少事自己做主。
zh.gap: 在第一个 agent 上线之前，就把「什么它能自己定、什么必须人来确认」说清楚——而不是等它当着客户的面出错之后。

options.en: We have not really discussed it
options.zh: 还没真正讨论过

options.en: It worries people enough that AI stays out of anything official
options.zh: 大家有顾虑，所以正式场合基本不用

options.en: There is an informal rule — a person checks the output
options.zh: 有个不成文的规矩：结果要有人过一眼

options.en: It is written down: what AI may decide alone, what a person must confirm
options.zh: 写下来了：哪些 AI 能自己定，哪些必须人来确认

en.prompt: Where are you with Microsoft 365 Copilot?
en.help: The gentlest on-ramp — AI where people already work.
en.gap: M365 Copilot puts AI where people already work, so the habit forms before anyone has to build anything. It is the easiest first step if you have not taken one.

zh.prompt: Microsoft 365 Copilot 现在是什么状态？
zh.help: 最平缓的入口——AI 出现在人们本来就在用的地方。
zh.gap: M365 Copilot 把 AI 放在人们本来就在用的地方，让习惯先长出来，然后才谈建什么。如果还没迈第一步，这是最省力的一步。

options.en: We do not have it
options.zh: 还没有

options.en: Evaluating, or running a small pilot
options.zh: 在评估，或者小范围试点

options.en: Some teams are licensed
options.zh: 部分团队已经有许可

options.en: Broadly deployed
options.zh: 已经铺得比较广

en.prompt: And Copilot Studio — the tool this programme builds in?
en.help: This is the one prerequisite with no substitute.
en.gap: Copilot Studio licences and an environment are the one prerequisite with no workaround, and arranging them is usually the longest lead time in the whole programme. Start it now.

zh.prompt: 那 Copilot Studio 呢？——这个项目就是在它上面建东西的
zh.help: 这是唯一一个没有替代品的前置条件。
zh.gap: Copilot Studio 的许可和环境，是唯一绕不过去的前置条件；而且它通常是整个项目里等待时间最长的一件事。现在就开始办。

options.en: We do not have it, or have not heard of it
options.zh: 没有，或者没听说过

options.en: We know of it, but it is not switched on
options.zh: 知道，但还没开通

options.en: Switched on, and a few people have tried it
options.zh: 已开通，少数人试过

options.en: Switched on, and someone here has already built something with it
options.zh: 已开通，而且已经有人用它做出过东西

en.prompt: Have you used low-code tools like Power Apps or Power Automate?
en.help: The skills carry over almost completely.
en.gap: Anyone who has built a Power Automate flow already has most of the skill this needs. If nobody has, budget more time for the first build than it appears to need.

zh.prompt: Power Apps、Power Automate 这类低代码工具，你们用过吗？
zh.help: 这里的技能几乎可以整套迁移过来。
zh.gap: 做过 Power Automate 流程的人，能力其实已经具备大半。如果一个都没有，请把第一次动手的时间预留得比看上去更长。

options.en: Never
options.zh: 没用过

options.en: A little, experimentally
options.zh: 试过一点点

options.en: We have a few apps or flows in real use
options.zh: 有几个应用或流程在实际使用

options.en: Used widely, with people who are genuinely fluent
options.zh: 用得比较多，也有几个真正的熟手

en.prompt: The documents and data an agent would need — where do they live?
en.help: An agent can only answer from what it can reach.
en.gap: An agent is only as good as what it can reach. Getting the first use case's documents into one place with sensible permissions is usually the highest-value week of preparation there is.

zh.prompt: agent 会用到的那些文档和数据，现在放在哪里？
zh.help: agent 只能基于它够得着的东西来回答。
zh.gap: agent 的上限，就是它够得着的那些东西。把第一个用例要用的文档收进一个地方、把权限理顺，通常是准备期里回报最高的一周。

options.en: Scattered — personal drives, email, people's heads
options.zh: 很散——个人电脑、邮件，还有人的脑子里

options.en: Mostly in older systems that would need development work to reach
options.zh: 多数在老系统里，要接得开发

options.en: A mix — some in SharePoint or Teams, some elsewhere
options.zh: 混合的——一部分在 SharePoint 或 Teams，一部分在别处

options.en: Mostly in SharePoint, Teams or Dynamics, with permissions already sorted
options.zh: 主要在 SharePoint、Teams 或 Dynamics 里，权限也理过了

en.prompt: If you needed a new licence or a place to build, could you get one?
en.help: Not whether it is allowed — whether you know who to ask, and roughly how long it takes.
en.gap: Find the person who can grant licences and environments, and ask them now. This is the single most common reason a first build stalls before it even starts.

zh.prompt: 如果需要一个新许可、或者一个能动手的环境，办得下来吗？
zh.help: 不是问允不允许，是问你知不知道该找谁、大概要多久。
zh.gap: 找到那个能批许可、能开环境的人，现在就去问。这是第一次动手还没开始就卡住的最常见原因，没有之一。

options.en: We would not know who to ask
options.zh: 不知道该找谁

options.en: There is a process, but it is a long one
options.zh: 有流程，但很长

options.en: We know who to ask, and it usually works out
options.zh: 知道找谁，一般也办得下来

options.en: Someone already manages this and can arrange it quickly
options.zh: 已经有人在管，能很快安排

en.prompt: Who do you most want to enable?
en.help: The honest answer, not the most ambitious one.

zh.help: 按真实想法答，不用挑听起来最有志向的那个。

options.en: Not sure yet — we want to see what is possible first
options.zh: 还没想好，想先看看能做到什么程度

options.en: Every business employee, so they can build small things themselves
options.zh: 每一位业务员工，让他们能自己做点小东西

options.en: A specialist team, who build things that many people then use
options.zh: 一个专业团队，由他们做出东西给很多人用

options.en: The IT team, to establish governance and a centre of excellence
options.zh: IT 团队，把治理和 CoE 建立起来

en.prompt: What would make this a success for you?
en.help: One finished thing and a repeatable capability are both legitimate goals — they just need different plans.

zh.prompt: 什么样的结果，你会认为这件事成了？
zh.help: 「做成一件事」和「长出一种能力」都是正当目标，只是需要不同的打法。

options.en: One specific thing built, and genuinely being used
options.zh: 有一件具体的事被做出来，而且真的在用

options.en: A handful of quick wins across different teams
options.zh: 在几个团队里各拿下一些小胜

options.en: A group of people who can keep building without us
options.zh: 有一批人，之后不靠我们也能继续建

options.en: This becomes how the organisation works, with governance to match
options.zh: 它变成组织的标准做法，配套的治理也建起来

en.prompt: What scope and timeframe do you have in mind?
en.help: Scope is what most often disagrees with the ambition above — which is exactly what this question is for.

zh.prompt: 你心里想的范围和时间是多大？
zh.help: 范围是最常和上面那个野心对不上的地方——而这正是这道题的用处。

options.en: One team, something visible within weeks
options.zh: 一个团队，几周内看到东西

options.en: One department, over a quarter
options.zh: 一个部门，一个季度左右

options.en: Several departments, over two or three quarters
options.zh: 几个部门，两三个季度

options.en: The whole organisation, as a multi-year change
options.zh: 整个组织，跨年度的转型
